title: Misawa disc flips on its edge

tellings.quote: Msawa, Japan, 1952 training uh exercise. Uh guys flying doing intercepts and he sees a disc come up to his plane

plain: A guest named Merrick, on a 2025 episode of Jesse Michels's podcast, describes a 1952 training exercise at Misawa, Japan, where military pilots were practising intercepts, meaning flying up to meet a target. According to him, one pilot saw a disc come right up to his plane and flip on its edge, which, if true, would be a close look at a disc-shaped craft by a trained flier.
